subject: 浑源圆觉寺塔
author: Zhangzhugang
source_note: 采用金代圆觉寺塔全景，八角九级密檐，非灵丘觉山寺十三层辽塔。参考照片为近正面略仰视，生成保持八角可见面、塔身开口与九道主檐；塔冠和须弥座线脚不当作额外层数。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Use only its elegant very thin black contours, subtle organic line variation, sparse internal detail and large empty white areas, never its Buddha shape. Image 2 is the real SUBJECT GEOMETRY: YUANJUE TEMPLE PAGODA 圆觉寺塔 in HUNYUAN 浑源, Shanxi, a Jin-dynasty brick pagoda built in 1158. Do not confuse it with the thirteen-storey Jueshan Temple pagoda in Lingqiu.
Draw exactly the photographed octagonal NINE-TIER close-eaved brick pagoda, complete from pedestal to the tip of its narrow metal finial. Preserve the distinctive tall first storey with arched doorway and brick imitation windows, the octagonal multi-level sculpted pedestal, the large brick imitation-wood dougong supporting the FIRST main eave, and precisely EIGHT more increasingly narrow dense eave tiers above it: NINE major eave roofs total. The shallow cornices of the pedestal do not count as pagoda storeys. Retain the unusual wider top drum, tapered silhouette, and the extremely slender openwork metal finial with its circular cage form and tiny bird at the tip, faithfully based on the photo. Maintain the visible octagonal faces and actual doorway orientation. Draw a calm centered near-frontal view, make verticals upright and reduce upward camera distortion gently without changing actual architecture. Do not turn the octagon into a square, add storeys or tall windowed chambers between the dense upper eaves.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. All roof and wall planes, doorways and recesses remain white. Use confident fine outer contours and fewer still-finer internal structure lines. Selectively outline key dougong arms and pedestal niches; suggest their small relief figures with just a few delicate curves, not dense sculpture rendering. Roof tiers need clear simple edges, no complete tile grid, no repeated brick courses. No solid shadows, grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, engraved texture, weathering, gradient, color or gold. Match the master visual density and leave spacious white areas.
Remove trees, vegetation, fences, dirt piles, construction notices, tourists, all neighbouring courtyard buildings, signs, wires and all text. Preserve only the tower itself and its full base. No invented grand staircase. No watermark, calligraphy, labels, caption, border or frame.
Portrait 1024 x 1536. Entire tower including its finial and pedestal occupies about 82 percent of the canvas height, centered with equal side margins and generous top and bottom white space. Nothing cropped. Only a few short ground lines.

site_recommendation.lede: 浑源古城中，圆觉寺留下了一座金代砖塔。高耸的首层托起九道渐次收分的密檐，砖雕模仿木构斗栱，纤细铁刹在顶端勾出独特的轮廓。
facts: 据《浑源州志》，现存砖塔建于金正隆三年（1158），明清多次修缮。
塔为八角九级密檐式，高约30米；塔身及台座以砖雕表现仿木构斗栱和装饰。
浑源圆觉寺塔于2013年列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。

verification: 输入输出均已查看：主塔九道密檐、较高首层、八角塔身、须弥座和细长铁刹完整；无树木围栏人物文字。
